dataset: Apache Jira Issue Tracking (Zenodo 5665896), 1,013,964 issues, 647 projects; 834,559 usable after filters

vegaml.protocol: fit on 120 labelled train issues, eval 100, mode=auto (TTT heads served)

laya.protocol: zero-shot english checkpoint, eval 100 (same eval indices)

caveats: vegaml fitted, laya zero-shot; laya.finetune not run (parity pending)
eval sets identical within each split but n=100, so +/-~5pp noise
dataset contains real-world spam issues (pharma etc.) - not filtered
